summary: Zion Oil & Gas filed an 8-K announcing Amendment No. 2 to its Dividend Reinvestment and Direct Stock Purchase Plan prospectus supplement (Form S-3 File No. 333-283500), extending its Unit Option Program from September 10, 2026 to September 25, 2026. Each $250.00 unit comprises shares priced at the OTCQX high/low average on the purchase date plus 75 warrants exercisable at $0.75 per share. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or counterparty is stated. This is a routine shelf/DSPP administrative update, not a special situation; watch warrant overhang and dilution.
